title: vt-multilingual-support.html
content: The now supports multiple languages. Admins can override the default language and customize users' language experiences when specific predefined criteria are met. For example, an Admin can change the language for users in a particular region. Content will be presented in a user’s preferred language or default to English if a language isn’t pre-selected. Users won’t have to manually select their language each time they interact with the system, and they can change the displayed language according to their preferences. Translate Custom Labels Blackthorn users can now translate the labels the user sees (and override the standard out-of-the-box values) when using the Virtual Terminal and the Payment Charge Flow. Before proceeding, you must enable s in your org. Then, follow one of the steps below to configure the custom labels.  If you are working with the , click Translate the Virtual Terminal .  If you are working with the and charge flows, click Translate the Payment Charge Flow . Translate the Payment Charge Flow Navigate to Setup. In the Quick Find box, enter and click "Custom Labels". Use the Categories column header to sort and find the “Payment Charge Flow” category. Custom Labels in the "PaymentChargeFlow" category have "ChargeFlow" as a prefix. Click on the Label you need to translate. Click New Translation / Local Override . Select your . Enter the for the label. Click . The language displayed will depend on the language configured in the User Settings of the user. Custom Labels The Payment Charge Flow custom labels are as follows.
